name: Python AI Integration: SDKs, Async, Pydantic, Packaging and Testing
description: A code-first course on integrating LLMs into Python the way production code needs it: uv projects and secrets, the OpenAI, Anthropic and Google GenAI SDKs side by side, async concurrency and streaming, Pydantic structured outputs and tools, retries, local models, embeddings and RAG, FastAPI and pandas integration, testing and evals with pytest, observability, cost tracking and deployment.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Python AI Integration: SDKs, Async, Pydantic, Packaging and Testing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 19 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 45 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
